package.name: ur_cable_pick_assemble_demo
package.description: Cable pick-and-ASSEMBLE for the UR10e + Robotiq 2F-85. Subclasses ur_cable_pick_place_demo, so the PICK is the same code path (SAM3 scan, connector estimate, grasp, groove check + recovery). What replaces "place" is an assembly: move to a stand-off off the target, switch to compliance control (admittance; toggleable), execute the ideal stand-off-to-target trajectory in force-guarded fractional chunks, release, restore position control, retract along a specified frame/axis, and return home. Assembly methods are pluggable (kinematic implemented; vision is a placeholder), and the target pose may be specified in the fingertip, tool0 or held-connector frame.
